stories.title: Bo Nix, after one of his worst games for Broncos, says 'I let the team down'
stories.summary: After one of the most difficult starts of his NFL career, Broncos quarterback Bo Nix said "I let the team down'' in a 27-5 loss to the Steelers on Friday.
stories.detail: PITTSBURGH -- After one of the most difficult starts of his NFL career, Denver Broncos quarterback Bo Nix said "I let the team down'' in a 27-5 loss to the Pittsburgh Steelers on Friday. The Broncos' first Black Friday game certainly won't go in Nix's scrapbook -- or the offense's -- as the Broncos mustered just 205 net yards, with a Nix fumble recovered for a touchdown and one of his two interceptions returned for a touchdown. "It's frustrating for sure and I let the team down,'' Nix said. "[That is] the last thing I want to do as a quarterback, as a leader of the team ... [My teammates] didn't let me get too down. I was wanting to get a little more down than they were letting me.'' In a game played in a steady rain with a windchill of 29 degrees at kickoff, Nix finished 22-of-49 passing for 169 yards and was sacked three times, with the three turnovers. It was the first time in Nix's 47 career starts (including regular season and playoffs) he had three turnovers and was sacked three times in the same game. The struggles in the rain were reminiscent of a 10-9 win over the Jets in 2024, his rookie year; Nix finished with a career-low 60 yards passing at a rain-swept MetLife Stadiu…

stories.title: Brock Purdy ruled out vs. Seahawks. Can Mac Jones carry 49ers offense?
stories.summary: Brock Purdy did not practice all week with a mid ankle sprain he suffered against the Vikings. Kyle Shanahan is optimistic his QB will be back soon.
stories.detail: The San Francisco 49ers will be without their quarterback for the first of their two-game NFC West leg this week. Brock Purdy has been ruled out for their Week 12 divisional matchup against the Seattle Seahawks , head coach Kyle Shanahan announced on Friday, Nov. 27. Mac Jones will get the start at home against the defending Super Bowl champions. Purdy sprained his left ankle in the second quarter of the Mexico City game against the Minnesota Vikings on Nov. 22, though he kept playing and finished with 255 passing yards and three touchdowns in a 35-10 win to push the Niners' NFL-best record to 9-1. He did not practice all week while nursing his ankle and despite Shanahan's optimism that he wouldn't miss time, Purdy is now being shut down for the week after it was revealed he suffered a mid-ankle sprain, which typically is slower to heal. Shanahan told reporters Friday that Purdy won't require surgery. Does he expect his franchise QB back next week against the Los Angeles Rams ? "It's too soon, but I mean I'm pretty optimistic about it," he said. "But I was (optimistic) about this week to start and then it changes, so hopefully it'll be all right." stories.title: Steelers players express support for Mike McCarthy after winning first game since Aaron Rodgers divorce
stories.summary: The Steelers had some things to discuss after Aaron Rodgers unleashed a laundry list of grievances against the head coach.
stories.detail: It can't be denied the Pittsburgh Steelers are a different team after one of the most eventful weeks of the season, but that apparently isn't all bad. A number of Steelers players expressed their support for head coach Mike McCarthy in the aftermath of a 27-5 win over the Denver Broncos on Black Friday , the team's first game since a very public divorce with starting quarterback Aaron Rodgers. The saga saw Rodgers make several claims while appearing on "The Pat McAfee Show" that painted McCarthy as disconnected at best and dangerously incompetent at worst after the Steelers benched him, and shortly before they released him. It's a situation with a little precedent in the NFL, and it led to all eyes on McCarthy and the Steelers in Week 12. stories.title: 49ers rule QB Brock Purdy (ankle) out; Mac Jones to start vs. Seahawks
stories.summary: 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy (ankle) will not play Sunday against the Seahawks, according to coach Kyle Shanahan, paving the way for Mac Jones to start.
stories.detail: SANTA CLARA, Calif. -- San Francisco 49ers quarterback Brock Purdy (ankle) will not play Sunday against the Seattle Seahawks , according to coach Kyle Shanahan. After the Niners wrapped up their third and final session of the week, Shanahan said Purdy has officially been ruled out against the Seahawks. Mac Jones will start in Purdy's place with Kurtis Rourke as his backup. "Anytime it's not a high ankle sprain, you get pretty relieved, but it was more mid than low, which is a little bit worse," Shanahan said Friday. "Kind of had a feeling just the way it was by the time Wednesday came around. [It] didn't heal up as fast as we wanted, so had to shut him down." Purdy initially injured his left ankle in the second quarter of last week's win against the Minnesota Vikings . The injury appeared to happen with about 30 seconds left in the opening half when Purdy tried to escape Vikings defensive lineman Jalen Redmond . As a flag for intentional grounding came out, Purdy's left ankle appeared to bend under Redmond as he took him to the ground. Shanahan said Wednesday he knew about Purdy's injury at halftime, and it did not affect his playcalling over the final two quarters. After initiall…

stories.title: Sam Darnold 'ready to roll' vs. 49ers as Seahawks fight to stay in NFC West race
stories.summary: Seahawks QB Sam Darnold, who missed the past two games with a quad injury, will return to start against the Niners in a pivotal NFC West showdown.
stories.detail: RENTON, Wash. -- After playing through a cracked rib and then missing the past two games because of a quad injury, quarterback Sam Darnold is back in the Seattle Seahawks ' starting lineup in time for their most pivotal matchup of the season. Coach Mike Macdonald confirmed Friday that Darnold will start Sunday against the San Francisco 49ers at Levi's Stadium, a game the Seahawks must win to keep any realistic hope alive of staying in the NFC West race. "I feel really good," Darnold said Friday after practicing as a full participant for the third straight day. "I'm not going to compare it to any other point in the season, but I feel really good right now." The Seahawks ruled out right tackle Abraham Lucas (ankle), left guard Quenton Nelson (knee) and defensive tackle Jarran Reed (toe). In addition to Darnold, they'll get left tackle Charles Cross (ankle) and defensive tackle Leonard Williams (stinger) back. Macdonald had said earlier in the week that the plan was for Darnold to start against the 49ers (9-1) as long as all went well Wednesday in a full-speed practice that followed a lighter session the Seahawks (6-4) had Monday as they returned from their bye. stories.title: Steelers credit T.J. Watt, Cam Heyward for leadership amidst adverse week
stories.summary: T.J. Watt, Cam Heyward, and Jalen Ramsey helped lead the Steelers out of a dark week
stories.detail: (Photo by Joe Sargent/Getty Images) | Getty Images The Pittsburgh Steelers responded to a very adverse week by dominating the Denver Broncos 27-5 to get to 7-4 and remain unbeaten at home in 2026. It was a trying week for the Steelers, who released quarterback Aaron Rodgers after he demanded to take over play-calling duties. Rodgers then went on The Pat McAfee Show and put head coach Mike McCarthy on blast for falling asleepp in meetings, missing walk throughs, and not getting to know defensive players, among other things. In trying times like this, teams lean on their leaders, and several players credited T.J. Watt and Cam Heyward for the work they did with the team this week. “I thought TJ and Cam did a really good job before the game,” Pat Freiermuth said via Brooke Pryor . “Really talking about it’s bigger than one person, it’s bigger than two people… It’s about the Rooney family and the Steelers and the fans, and they deserve our best effort today.” Safety Jaquan Brisker echoed those sentiments. “We had a very important leadership council meeting this week, and we all were in there and talked about keeping this team together and turning the page,” Brisker said via Nick Faraba…

teamStories.summary: Raiders tight end Brock Bowers is questionable for Sunday night's game at Cleveland because of an ankle injury he suffered in Week 10. Las Vegas will also be missing two of its starting defensive tackles and a backup.
teamStories.detail: HENDERSON, Nev. -- Brock Bowers ' status for the Las Vegas Raiders ' matchup against the Cleveland Browns is uncertain, as the All-Pro tight end is questionable to play Sunday night because of an ankle injury. Bowers missed practice Friday after being limited Wednesday and Thursday. Coach Klint Kubiak didn't say whether Bowers' absence was a scheduled rest day to get him healthier for the Week 12 contest. "We're doing everything we can to get him ready for the game," Kubiak said. Kubiak didn't elaborate on whether the team will conduct a pregame workout for Bowers, or if the star pass catcher had any setbacks while recovering from the injury, which happened on the Raiders' opening drive in Week 10 and kept him out of last week's game against Denver . Bowers began the practice week without tape on his right ankle. On Thursday, his ankle was heavily taped up, and he was not seen on the practice field Friday. "He's working through what works for him," Kubiak said. "What makes him feel the best and what he can play his best at, whether it's with or without the tape." Kubiak reiterated that the team's upcoming Week 13 bye week will not factor into the decision to play Bowers on Sunday.…

stories.title: Isaiah Joe scores 22 points, Pistons' reserves power NBA Cup win over Bucks
stories.summary: — Isaiah Joe scored 22 points to help the Detroit Pistons overcome a slow start and beat the Milwaukee Bucks 113-98 in an NBA Cup game Friday night.
stories.detail: DETROIT -- — Isaiah Joe scored 22 points to help the Detroit Pistons overcome a slow start and beat the Milwaukee Bucks 113-98 in an NBA Cup game Friday night. The Pistons wpn East Group A at 3-1 with a better points differential than the Toronto Raptors and Orlando Magic . Detroit will host a knockout-round game and could finish with the Eastern Conference's top seed. The Bucks finished 0-4 in group play. The Pistons, who finished with seven players in double figures, were missing three starters — Jalen Duren (hamstring) and Duncan Robinson (quadriceps) have been out for weeks, and Cade Cunningham (knee) also was in street clothes. Paul Reed and fellow reserve Elijah Harkless added 14 points. Detroit had 60 bench points while the starters finished with 53. Rookie Brayden Burries had 23 points for the Bucks and Tyler Herro added 20. Milwaukee led by 16 points in the first quarter, but only had a two-point advantage at halftime. The Pistons then put up a 42-point third quarter that included points from eight players. Daniss Jenkins ' 3-pointer at the buzzer put Detroit up 90-78 at quarter's end. stories.title: NBA Cup 2026: Pistons and Sixers join Mavericks in clinching spot in knockout round
stories.summary: The knockout rounds of the 2026 NBA Cup are coming into focus in the final night of group play action.
stories.detail: The knockout rounds of the 2026 NBA Cup are coming into focus in the final night of group play action. Only one of eight spots in the next round had been determined going into Friday, as the Dallas Mavericks held a 3-0 record and the tiebreaker over the Denver Nuggets, the only 2-1 team in West Group A. They were advancing no matter how their final game went. The Detroit Pistons quickly joined them in advancing, handling the Milwaukee Bucks 113-98 to finish group play with a 3-1 record and the best point differential in East Group A. The Philadelphia 76ers joined them almost simultaneously with a win over the Indiana Pacers, taking East Group B via tiebreaker over the Miami Heat. stories.title: Antetokounmpo has 22 points and 23 rebounds as the Heat stop the Knicks' 6-game winning streak
stories.summary: — Giannis Antetokounmpo had 22 points and a career-high 23 rebounds, Bam Adebayo scored 25 points and the Miami Heat ended the New York Knicks' six-game winning streak and NBA Cup title reign with a 108-105 victory Friday night.
stories.detail: NEW YORK -- — Giannis Antetokounmpo had 22 points and a career-high 23 rebounds, Bam Adebayo scored 25 points and the Miami Heat ended the New York Knicks ' six-game winning streak and NBA Cup title reign with a 108-105 victory Friday night. The Knicks erased a 23-point deficit to grab the lead in the fourth quarter, but Jalen Brunson hit only two of three free throws when he was fouled shooting a 3-pointer with 9.8 seconds remaining and the Heat held on. Miami would win its group if Philadelphia lost in Indiana, but the 76ers had a huge lead in the fourth quarter. Brunson had 27 points and eight assists for the Knicks, who needed to win by at least seven points and have the 76ers lose to have a chance to become the first team to advance to the knockout round of the tournament with a 2-2 record. Karl-Anthony Towns had 19 points and 10 rebounds while playing with an abdominal injury that had him listed as questionable until shortly before the game and wincing in pain a few times during it. The Heat went 6 for 11 on 3s and the Knicks were 2 for 11 in the first quarter as Miami led 31-21. Towns got the first two baskets of the second before the Heat ran off 15 straight points for a 4…

The Hoosiers were shooting well, defending well, and rebounding well in what may have been the most complete performance from this group so far. Though it wasn’t a marquee win like last week’s victories over Arkansas or Kentucky, the margin of victory was one that boosted Indiana’s computer profile. KenPom only favored Indiana by 20 entering the game, so the blowout moved Indiana up five spots in the national ranking. Over the summer, the league unveiled the full group stage schedule for the in-season tournament, with action taking place every Friday from Oct. 30 to Nov. 27 and on special Cup nights during Thanksgiving week (Nov. 24-25). After the New York Knicks became the first team to win the NBA Cup and Finals in the same season, Jalen Brunson & Co. won't be able to keep their championship run going. They were eliminated on the final day of group play with a loss to the Miami Heat . Here's what you need to know about the in-season tournament, now in its fourth year.
